parts.latex:
An item was purchased for a price of \$880, including $10\%$ GST.

What is the amount of GST included in the price?

solutions.latex:
The price including GST is $110\%$ of the price before GST.
$$\begin{aligned} \text{Price before GST} &= \dfrac{880}{1.1} \\ &= \$800 \end{aligned}$$
$$\begin{aligned} \text{GST} &= 880 - 800 \\ &= \$80.00 \end{aligned}$$
This is option C.

parts.latex:
An item is discounted by $30\%$ and then a further discount of $20\%$ is applied to the reduced price.

What is the total percentage discount?

solutions.latex:
A $30\%$ discount leaves $70\%$ of the price, and a further $20\%$ discount leaves $80\%$ of that.
$$\begin{aligned} \text{final price} &= 0.7\times 0.8\times \text{original}\\ &= 0.56\times\text{original} \end{aligned}$$
The total discount is
$$100\% - 56\% = 44\%$$
This is option B.

parts.latex:
A receipt from a supermarket shows a total of \$124.87. The GST shown on the receipt is \$3.86.

GST, at a rate of $10\%$, is only charged on some items.

What was the value of the items which did NOT have GST charged?

solutions.latex:
GST is $10\%$ of the value $n$ of the items charged.
$$\begin{aligned}0.1\times n &= 3.86\\ n &= \$38.60\end{aligned}$$
The total includes the GST and the items charged.
$$\begin{aligned}\text{Items without GST} &= 124.87-38.60-3.86\\ &= \$82.41\end{aligned}$$
criteria: Calculates the difference between the total and the amount on which GST is charged, or equivalent merit
Calculates the amount on which GST is charged, or equivalent merit

parts.latex:
A sports store sells jerseys priced at \$169.95, including 10% goods and services tax (GST).

What is the amount of GST included in the price?

solutions.latex:
The price includes GST, so it is $110\%$ of the pre-GST price. The GST is $\dfrac{10}{110} = \dfrac{1}{11}$ of the price paid.
$$\begin{aligned} \text{GST} &= \dfrac{169.95}{11} \\ &= \$15.45 \end{aligned}$$
This is option A.

meta.self_check: 169.95/11 = 15.45 in Python; pre-GST price 154.50, 10% of it 15.45.

parts.latex:
A bill for servicing a car is made up of:

\begin{itemize}
\item \$242 for parts, which includes $10\%$ GST
\item \$100 for labour, excluding GST.
\end{itemize}

The mechanic needs to add $10\%$ GST onto the labour charge.

How much GST does the customer pay in total?

solutions.latex:
The parts price includes $10\%$ GST, so it is $110\%$ of the price before GST. The GST on the parts is
$$\dfrac{10}{110}\times 242 = \$22$$
The GST added to the labour is
$$10\% \times 100 = \$10$$
The total GST is
$$22 + 10 = \$32.00$$
Hence the answer is C.
